test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Identify the sentence with correct subject-verb agreement:

options.text: The quick judgments of our intuitive mind, what I call System 1, is accurate enough to help us navigate the world.
This division of labor work well most of the time, but it also creates predictable errors.
Understanding these two systems can helps us recognize when we are relying too much on intuition.
System 2 allocates attention to effortful mental activities, such as solving complex problems or evaluating logical arguments.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **Option 4**, the subject *System 2* is singular, and the verb **allocates** is correctly used in singular form. This makes the sentence grammatically correct.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In Option 1, the subject is plural (*judgments*), so the verb should be are instead of is. Hence, it is incorrect.
 
• In Option 2, the subject is singular (*division*), so the verb should be works instead of work. Hence, it is incorrect.
 
• In Option 3, the base verb *can* should be followed by the root form help, not helps. Hence, it is incorrect.
